This script compares gut microbiota data from Papua New Guinea (PNG) Hydromyini with the reference dataset from Youngblut et al. (2019): https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-019-10191-3


# Packages and functions

```{r }

small_fig<-function(GG){
  GG+theme(axis.title = element_text(size=8),
           axis.text = element_text(size=6),
           plot.title=element_text(size=8),
           legend.text = element_text(size=8),
           legend.key.size = unit(0.5,"line"))
}

manage_unassigned<-function(PHYLOSEQ,UNASS_STRING=NA,ADD,AFTER=TRUE){
  TAXall<-data.frame(tax_table(PHYLOSEQ),stringsAsFactors = F)
  if(!is.na(UNASS_STRING)){TAXall[UNASS_STRING]<-NA}
  # TAXall<-as.character(TAXall[i,])
  for(i in 1:dim(TAXall)[1]){  
    TAX<-as.character(TAXall[i,])
    if(AFTER==TRUE) {for(j in 2: length(TAX)){
      if(is.na(TAX[j])){TAX[j]<-ifelse(regexpr(ADD,TAX[j-1])>0,
                                       TAX[j-1],paste(TAX[j-1],ADD,sep=""))}}}
    if(AFTER==FALSE) {for(j in 2: length(TAX)){
      if(is.na(TAX[j])){TAX[j]<-ifelse(regexpr(ADD,TAX[j-1])>0,
                                       TAX[j-1],ADD,paste(TAX[j-1],sep=""))}}}
    TAXall[i,]<-TAX
  }
  TAXA<-colnames(TAXall)
  SPECIES<-rownames(TAXall)
  TAXall<-tax_table(TAXall)
  taxa_names(TAXall)<-SPECIES
  colnames(TAXall)<-TAXA
  tax_table(PHYLOSEQ)<-TAXall
  
  #output
  PHYLOSEQ
}


prepare_tax_df<-function(PHYLOSEQ,RANK,Unass.symbol=NA,Unass.repl,
                         min_prop,top_tax,bellow_top,
                         merge_categories,prop.trans,sort_abu){
  if(prop.trans==T){PHYLOSEQ=transform_sample_counts(PHYLOSEQ,function(x) x/sum(x))}
  TT<-tax_table(PHYLOSEQ)
  class(TT)<-"matrix"
  TT[is.na(tax_table(TT))]<-Unass.repl
  TT<-tax_table(TT)
  tax_table(PHYLOSEQ)<-TT
  
  PHYLOSEQ.merged<-tax_glom(PHYLOSEQ,taxrank=RANK)
  PHYLOSEQ.merged=transform_sample_counts(PHYLOSEQ.merged,function(x) x/sum(x))
  
  #select top taxa
  NAMES<-as.character(tax_table(PHYLOSEQ.merged)[,RANK])
  TS<-taxa_sums(PHYLOSEQ.merged)
  names(TS)<-NAMES
  TS<-rev(sort(TS))
  KEEP<-names(TS)[1:top_tax]
  
  #
  TT<-tax_table(PHYLOSEQ.merged)
  class(TT)<-"matrix"
  TT[,RANK][!TT[,RANK]%in%KEEP]<-bellow_top
  TT<-tax_table(TT)
  tax_table(PHYLOSEQ.merged)<-TT
  PHYLOSEQ.merged<-tax_glom(PHYLOSEQ.merged,taxrank=RANK)
  
  mdf = psmelt(PHYLOSEQ.merged)
  
  if(sort_abu==T){
    mdf[,RANK]<-as.factor(mdf[,RANK])
    ADD<-levels(mdf[,RANK])[!levels(mdf[,RANK])%in%KEEP]
    if(length(ADD)>0){mdf[,RANK]<-factor(mdf[,RANK],levels=c(KEEP,ADD))}
    if(length(ADD)==0){mdf[,RANK]<-factor(mdf[,RANK],levels=c(KEEP))}
  }
  
  mdf
}

```

# Merge data on PNG rodents with Youngblut et al. (2019)

```{r }
##########################
#1a: Youngblut data#######
##########################

load("data/PHS.mam.sp.fam.Rdata")

##########################
#1b: PNG data#############
##########################

#- keep Hydromyni samples
#- Merge samples according to host species identity
#- Create family-level ASV binc

load("data/PHS.rodents.ASV_Meta_Decont_final.R")
PHS.h<-prune_samples(sample_data(PHS)$Tribe.2=="Hydromyini",
                     PHS)

SD.unq<-sample_data(PHS.h)
SD.unq<-SD.unq[!duplicated(SD.unq$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others),]
sample_names(SD.unq)<-SD.unq$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others
PHS.h.sp<-merge_samples(PHS.h,"Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others")
sample_data(PHS.h.sp)<-SD.unq

#familylevel
PHS.h.sp.f<-tax_glom(PHS.h.sp,"Family")
PHS.h.sp.f<-prune_taxa(as.character(tax_table(PHS.h.sp.f)[,"Family"])!="Incertae Sedis",
                       PHS.h.sp.f)# remove "Incertae Sedis"

taxa_names(PHS.h.sp.f)<-as.character(tax_table(PHS.h.sp.f)[,"Family"])


##############################
#2: Metadata adjustments######
##############################

# Keep only relevant variables from PNG and Youngblut et al. (2019) phyloseq
# Make metadata compatible

PHS.h.sp.f2<-PHS.h.sp.f
SD<-sample_data(PHS.h.sp.f2)
names(sample_data(PHS.h.sp.f2))
KEEP<-c("Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others","Diet")
SD.sub<-SD[,KEEP]
names(SD.sub)<-c("Host","Diet")
sample_data(PHS.h.sp.f2)<-SD.sub
sample_data(PHS.h.sp.f2)$Order<-"Rodentia"
sample_data(PHS.h.sp.f2)$Family<-"Muridae"

PHS.mam.sp.fam2<-PHS.mam.sp.fam
SD<-sample_data(PHS.mam.sp.fam2)
names(sample_data(PHS.mam.sp.fam2))
KEEP<-c("host_taxonomy_species","diet","host_taxonomy_order","host_taxonomy_family")
SD.sub<-SD[,KEEP]
names(SD.sub)<-c("Host","Diet","Order","Family")
SD.sub$Family<-ifelse(SD.sub$Family=="Muridae","Muridae","Others")
SD.sub$Order<-ifelse(SD.sub$Order=="Rodentia","Rodentia","Others")
sample_data(PHS.mam.sp.fam2)<-SD.sub

sample_data(PHS.h.sp.f2)$Dataset<-"Hydromyni"
sample_data(PHS.mam.sp.fam2)$Dataset<-"Mammals"


PHS.merged<-merge_phyloseq(PHS.mam.sp.fam2,
                           PHS.h.sp.f2)

```

# PCoA for Bray-Curtis dissimilarities

- Dissimilarities calculated based on family-level, abundances converted to proportions 

```{r }
PHS.merged.t<-transform_sample_counts(PHS.merged,function(x) x/sum(x))
BC<-vegdist(otu_table(PHS.merged.t)^0.5)
ORD<-ordinate(PHS.merged.t,distance = BC, method = "PCoA")

sample_data(PHS.merged.t)$Dataset2<-gsub("Mammals","Mammals (global dataset)",
                                         sample_data(PHS.merged.t)$Dataset)

gg_ORD<-
plot_ordination(PHS.merged.t,ORD,color="Diet",shape="Family")+
  facet_grid(.~Dataset2)

gg_ORD.s<-small_fig(gg_ORD+theme_bw())+theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                                             legend.box = "vertical",
                                             legend.title = element_blank())+
  xlab("PCoA.1 [27.7%]")+ylab("PCoA.2 [11.8%]")

ggsave(gg_ORD.s,filename="results/PCoA_PNG_Youngblut.pdf",
       width = 12, height = 12, units = "cm")

gg_ORD.s

```

# Comparing dissimilarities among PNG Hydromyni and Youngblut species - stratified by dietary guilds

```{r }

# Extract relevant dissimilarity values from the matrix
BC.m<-as.matrix(BC)
SD.all<-data.frame(sample_data(PHS.merged.t))
SD.Hydro<-SD.all[SD.all$Dataset=="Hydromyni",]
SD.Young<-SD.all[SD.all$Dataset!="Hydromyni",]

BC.m.sub<-BC.m[SD.all$Dataset=="Hydromyni",SD.all$Dataset!="Hydromyni"]

# Dissimilarity values for each category
Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.carniv<-as.numeric(BC.m.sub[SD.Hydro$Diet=="carnivore", SD.Young$Diet=="carnivore"])
Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.omniv<-as.numeric(BC.m.sub[SD.Hydro$Diet=="carnivore", SD.Young$Diet=="omnivore"])
Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.herbiv<-as.numeric(BC.m.sub[SD.Hydro$Diet=="carnivore", SD.Young$Diet=="herbivore"])

Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.carniv<-as.numeric(BC.m.sub[SD.Hydro$Diet=="omnivore", SD.Young$Diet=="carnivore"])
Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.omniv<-as.numeric(BC.m.sub[SD.Hydro$Diet=="omnivore", SD.Young$Diet=="omnivore"])
Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.herbiv<-as.numeric(BC.m.sub[SD.Hydro$Diet=="omnivore", SD.Young$Diet=="herbivore"])

Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.carniv<-as.numeric(BC.m.sub[SD.Hydro$Diet=="herbivore", SD.Young$Diet=="carnivore"])
Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.omniv<-as.numeric(BC.m.sub[SD.Hydro$Diet=="herbivore", SD.Young$Diet=="omnivore"])
Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.herbiv<-as.numeric(BC.m.sub[SD.Hydro$Diet=="herbivore", SD.Young$Diet=="herbivore"])

# Data frame for analyses and vizualization
Dissimilarity<-c(Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.carniv,Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.omniv,Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.herbiv,
                 Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.carniv,Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.omniv,Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.herbiv,
                 Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.carniv,Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.omniv,Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.herbiv)


Hydromyni.diet<-c(
  rep("carnivore",c(length(c(Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.carniv,Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.omniv,Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.herbiv)))),
  rep("omnivore",c(length(c(Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.carniv,Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.omniv,Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.herbiv)))),
  rep("herbivore",c(length(c(Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.carniv,Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.omniv,Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.herbiv))))
)

Mammalian.diet<-c(
rep("carnivore",length(Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.carniv)),
rep("omnivore",length(Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.omniv)),
rep("herbivore",length(Hydromyni.carniv_Mammals.herbiv)),

rep("carnivore",length(Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.carniv)),
rep("omnivore",length(Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.omniv)),
rep("herbivore",length(Hydromyni.omniv_Mammals.herbiv)),

rep("carnivore",length(Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.carniv)),
rep("omnivore",length(Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.omniv)),
rep("herbivore",length(Hydromyni.herbiv_Mammals.herbiv)))

DF_diet<-data.frame(Dissimilarity,Hydromyni.diet,Mammalian.diet)

DF_diet$Mammalian.diet<-factor(DF_diet$Mammalian.diet,
                               levels = c("carnivore","omnivore","herbivore"))
DF_diet$Hydromyni.diet<-factor(DF_diet$Hydromyni.diet,
                               levels = c("carnivore","omnivore","herbivore"))

levels(DF_diet$Hydromyni.diet)<-c("Hydromyni carniv.",
                                  "Hydromyni omniv.",
                                  "Hydromyni herbiv.")

levels(DF_diet$Mammalian.diet)<-c("Global\ncarniv.",
                                  "Global\nomniv.",
                                  "Global\nherbiv.")

# Comparission: PNG x Youngblut guilsd
# Based on Dunn tests 
stat.test <- DF_diet %>%
  group_by(Mammalian.diet) %>%
  dunn_test(Dissimilarity ~ Hydromyni.diet, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni") %>%
  add_y_position(step.increase = 0.25)

stat.test_sig <- stat.test %>% 
  filter(p.adj < 0.05)%>%
  add_y_position(step.increase = 0.3)

# Vizualization 
GG_contrast<-
ggplot(DF_diet, aes(y = Dissimilarity, x = Hydromyni.diet, color = Hydromyni.diet)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.1, width = 0.2,size=0.5) +
  facet_grid(Mammalian.diet ~ .) +
  # Add horizontal comparison lines and significance labels
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test_sig,
    #label = "p.adj.signif"
    hide.ns = TRUE,
    tip.length = 0.01
  )

GG_contrast<-GG_contrast+scale_color_manual(values = c("#F8766D", "#619CFF", "#00BA38"))

GG_contrast.s<-small_fig(GG_contrast+theme_bw())
GG_contrast.s<-GG_contrast.s+theme(strip.text = element_text(size=8),
                                   axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                                   axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                                   legend.position = "none")

GG_contrast.s<-GG_contrast.s+ylim(c(0.35,1.25))
ggsave(GG_contrast.s,filename="results/BoxPlots_PNG_Youngblut.pdf",
       width = 12, height = 12, units = "cm")

GG_contrast.s



```

# Barplots for dominant families

```{r }
library(Polychrome)
P25 <-distinct_palette(n = 22, add = NA)
P25<- unname(glasbey.colors(n = 23))
P25<-P25[2:22]
DF.genus.s<-prepare_tax_df(PHYLOSEQ=PHS.merged.t,
                           RANK="Family",Unass.symbol=NA,
                           Unass.repl="Unassigned",min_prop=NULL,top_tax=20,
                           bellow_top="Others",merge_categories=NULL,
                           prop.trans=TRUE,sort_abu=TRUE)

LEV<-names(rev(sort(tapply(DF.genus.s$Abundance,DF.genus.s$Family,mean))))
LEV
DF.genus.s$Family<-as.factor(DF.genus.s$Family)
DF.genus.s$Family<-factor(DF.genus.s$Family,levels = LEV)

DF.genus.s$Diet2<-DF.genus.s$Diet
DF.genus.s$Diet2<-gsub("vore","v.",DF.genus.s$Diet2)
DF.genus.s$Diet2<-factor(DF.genus.s$Diet2,
                         levels=c("carniv.","omniv.","herbiv."))

DF.genus.s$Dataset2<-DF.genus.s$Dataset
DF.genus.s$Dataset2<-gsub("Mammals","Mammals (global dataset)",DF.genus.s$Dataset2)

DF.genus.s$Host<-gsub("_"," ",DF.genus.s$Host)
DF.genus.s$Host_styled <- ifelse(
  DF.genus.s$sample_Family == "Muridae",
  paste0("<span style='color:red;'><b>", DF.genus.s$Host, "</b></span>"),
  DF.genus.s$Host
)

names(P25)<-levels(DF.genus.s$Family)
P25[names(P25)=="Others"]<-"gray80"

# 2. Build your plot using "Host_styled" on the x-axis
ta3 <- ggplot(DF.genus.s, aes(x = Host_styled, y = Abundance, fill = Family)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  facet_nested(. ~ Dataset2 + Diet2, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = P25) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text   = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.0, "lines"),
    # Use element_markdown() to render the HTML spans
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(
      angle = 90, 
      vjust = 0.5, 
      hjust = 1, 
      size  = 6
    )
  )

ta3.s<-small_fig(ta3)
ta3.s.family<-ta3.s+theme(strip.text = element_text(size=8),
                                axis.text.y = element_text(size=8),
                          axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 5),
                                 axis.title.y = element_text(size=8),
                                 legend.title = element_blank(),
                                 legend.position = "bottom",
                                 panel.spacing = unit(0.0, "lines"))


ggsave(ta3.s.family,filename="results/Taxplot_PNG_Youngblut.pdf",
       width = 18, height = 12, units = "cm")

ta3.s.family
```
